# Autocuts

> Autocuts is a local-first Mac screen recorder and video editor with automatic click zoom, smooth cursor motion, screen and camera layouts, a voice-paced teleprompter, on-device captions, and editable motion graphics. It records internal audio without a virtual audio driver such as BlackHole, and runs natively on MacBook Air, MacBook Pro, iMac, and Mac mini. It makes polished product demos, tutorials, developer walkthroughs, courses, launch videos, and social media videos.

Autocuts records a display, app window, or selected area with optional camera, microphone, and system audio. It keeps recordings and project data inside the app on the user's Mac. Editing and export run in the desktop app. Finished videos can be shared with free lifetime share links that upload the video to the user's own Google Drive, or exported as local files and hosted anywhere. The first transcription can download a speech model; after the model is available, transcription runs on the Mac.

Motion-graphic suggestions are optional. When a user selects Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, or Cursor CLI, that coding agent receives narration text and word timing; whether the text is processed locally or online depends on the selected agent and account. The recording video is not sent to the coding agent. Motion graphics can also be added manually without transcript analysis.

Autocuts is built for Apple Silicon Macs, with macOS Sonoma 14 or later recommended. A user can record and retain a video before buying. Processing, transcription, raw-file access, and export require a $19.99 lifetime license for one person on up to two Macs. Lifetime updates are included and there is no subscription.

## Product features

- [Screen recorder and video editor for Mac](https://autocuts.ai/features/screen-recorder-and-video-editor-for-mac/): Complete capture-to-export workflow for clips, zooms, cursor effects, layouts, captions, and graphics
- [Motion graphics for screen recordings](https://autocuts.ai/features/add-motion-graphics-to-videos/): Editable lower thirds, stats, callouts, quotes, lists, and highlights; add manually or generate transcript-aware suggestions with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, or Cursor CLI
- [Automatic zoom](https://autocuts.ai/features/mac-screen-recorder-with-auto-zoom/): Generate editable zooms from recorded clicks
- [Screen recorder with audio](https://autocuts.ai/features/screen-recorder-with-audio/): Capture system audio and microphone together with no virtual driver
- [MacBook and Mac support](https://autocuts.ai/features/screen-recorder-for-macbook/): Screen recording on MacBook Air, MacBook Pro, iMac, and Mac mini, native on Apple Silicon at full Retina resolution
- [Screen recorder with keyboard shortcuts](https://autocuts.ai/features/screen-recorder-with-keyboard-shortcuts/): Start, pause, stop, and switch displays with global shortcuts
- [Screen and camera recording](https://autocuts.ai/features/screen-and-camera-recorder-for-mac/): Capture a display, window, or area with webcam, microphone, and system audio
- [Built-in teleprompter](https://autocuts.ai/features/screen-recorder-with-teleprompter/): Voice-paced script with word highlighting that stays outside the recording
- [Local recording](https://autocuts.ai/features/local-screen-recorder-for-mac/): Local files, editing, transcription, and export details
- [Transcript cleanup](https://autocuts.ai/features/transcript-video-cleanup/): On-device transcript navigation, filler-word cleanup, captions, SRT, and VTT
- [Free share links](https://autocuts.ai/features/share-links/): Free lifetime share links; the finished video uploads to the user's own Google Drive
- [No-subscription recorder](https://autocuts.ai/mac-screen-recorder-no-subscription/): One-time $19.99 lifetime license, trial behavior, and refund window

## Current technical facts

- Platform: macOS desktop app built for Apple Silicon
- Recommended system: macOS Sonoma 14 or later
- Capture: display, window, or selected area; camera; microphone; system audio
- Editing: trim, split, speed, zooms, cursor, layouts, backgrounds, transcript, captions, and motion graphics
- Motion graphics: lower thirds, stats, callouts, quotes, lists, and highlights; manual placement or transcript-aware suggestions through a supported user-installed coding agent
- Export: MP4 H.264 or WebM VP9, up to 4K at 60 fps; optional SRT and VTT files
- Storage: local Autocuts folder inside the Mac Videos directory
- Account: no app account in the current build
- Analytics: no third-party desktop-app analytics in the current build
